definitions.explanation: Used with negative verb forms to express that something will not happen again. Emphasizes finality and determination.

examples.japanese: {二度|にど}と⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will never make that kind of mistake again.
I will never go to that store again.

examples.japanese: {二度|にど}と⟦{会|あ}いたくない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I never want to see (them) again.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二度|にど}と⟦ごめん→御免：00072_gomen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I never want to go through an experience like this again.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧ (two times) + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (emphatic particle)

GRAMMAR: Always used with NEGATIVE verb forms or expressions. Cannot be used with positive statements.

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - softer "no longer, not anymore"
- {二度|にど}と〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - stronger, more emphatic "never again"
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}に→絶対に：08722_zettaini⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - "absolutely never"

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二度|にど}と〜⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (I will never do ~ again)
- {二度|にど}と〜⟦したくない→する：00392_suru⟧ (I never want to ~ again)
- {二度|にど}と〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (~ will never happen again)
- {二度|にど}と⟦ごめん→御免：00072_gomen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (I've had enough of ~, never again)

USAGE NOTE: Expresses strong resolution or regret. Often used when someone has had a bad experience and is determined not to repeat it.
